DETAIL: [WRONG_APPLICABILITY] TRF-043-ShipShape > sh:property[nltl:hasComponent]: The unqualified sh:class nltl:frame and sh:node FrameShape constraints apply to every value of the generic hasComponent path, so unrelated ship components are incorrectly required to be frames and satisfy the framing-ice-strengthening constraints. Required change: Constrain only hasComponent values that are nltl:frame instances, using a qualified value shape or an equivalent frame-selective path while preserving validation of each applicable frame.
